meta.title: E06 · Modern battlefield — fibre FPV, low-rate links, decoys
meta.description: The 2024-26 picture: ~30% of FPV operators on fibre (no RF), ~30% on long-range low-rate spread links (below an energy detector), and 2 decoy emitters per map. bladeRF · combined · crossing grid, Frontline RF on. A bare payload, B adds a filter→LNA front end, C adds the three DSP countermeasures, D is the fused payload with everything. Shows what the new tech costs (fibre ceiling, decoy false fixes) and what the countermeasures buy back (low-rate links via cyclostationary).
